prayerTimes.title: Amaxesha emithandazo

prayerTimes.adjustmentHelper: Yishiye kwi-"Akukho" ukuba umhla ubonisiweyo uyafana nalowo ulandelwa kummandla wakho.
prayerTimes.aboutHijriParagraph1: Imihla yeHijri ibalwa kwaye isenokwahluka ngosuku olunye ngokuxhomekeke ekubonweni kwenyanga nasezibhengezweni ezisemthethweni zalapha ekhaya.
prayerTimes.aboutHijriParagraph2: Ilizwe elibonisiweyo liyafana nendawo esetyenziselwa amaxesha akho emithandazo. Ayithethi ukuba i-AWA ifumana ngokuzenzekelayo izibhengezo ezisemthethweni zelo lizwe.

qadaa.title: Intsuku zokuzila ezifanele ziphindwe
qadaa.allHamdulillahSubtitle: Al-hamdulillah, uphelele kwiintsuku zakho zokuzila ezifanele ziphindwe.
qadaa.reminderTextActive: Usenazo iintsuku zokuzila ekufuneka uziphinde. Lungiselela umkhondo wakho ngesantya sakho.
qadaa.reminderTextIdle: Ukuba kukho iintsuku ezintsha ezifanele ziphindwe, siza kukwazisa emva kweRamadan.
qadaa.aboutText: Iintsuku zokuzila ezilityiwe ngenxa yexesha lenyanga ngexesha leRamadan kufuneka ziphindwe kamva. Allah ungoyena wazi kakhulu.
qadaa.completionSubtitle: Rekhoda usuku oluphindiweyo ukuze uhlaziye umkhondo wakho.
qadaa.heroAccessibilityLoading: Iyalayisha umkhondo wakho wentsuku zokuzila ezifanele ziphindwe
qadaa.heroAccessibilityZero: Uphelele, akukho suku lokuzila olufanele luphindwe ngoku
qadaa.undoCompletionMessage_one: {{title}}: usuku olu-{{count}} oluphindiweyo luza kubuyiselwa kwibhalansi yakho.
qadaa.undoCompletionMessage_other: {{title}}: iintsuku ezi-{{count}} eziphindiweyo ziza kubuyiselwa kwibhalansi yakho.
qadaa.helpParagraph1: Esi sahluko sikunceda ukulandelela iintsuku zokuzila ezilityiwe ngenxa yexesha lenyanga ngexesha leRamadan.
qadaa.helpParagraph2: Iintsuku ezifunyenwe ngokuzenzekelayo zivela kumkhondo wakho wexesha lenyanga ngexesha leRamadan. Ungazongeza ngokwakho iintsuku, nokuba zindala. Xa uphinda usuku, lufake njengoluphelelisiweyo ukuze inani leentsuku ezisele lihlale lichanekile.
qadaa.ledger.surplusNote_one: Usuku olu-{{count}} oluphindiweyo ngaphezu kwesiphumo sangoku. Lusahlala kurekhodo: unokulususa kwimbali.
qadaa.ledger.surplusNote_other: Iintsuku ezi-{{count}} eziphindiweyo ngaphezu kwesiphumo sangoku. Zisahlala kurekhodo: unokuzisusa kwimbali.
qadaa.ledger.automaticHint: Ifunyenwe kumkhondo wakho wexesha lenyanga (ayihlelwa apha)
qadaa.form.description: Yongeza iintsuku zokuzila ozaziyo ukuba kufuneka uziphinde, nokuba zibuya kwiminyaka emininzi eyadlulayo. Ungazihlela okanye uzicime nangaliphi na ixesha.
qadaa.form.step2Title: Uyalazi ukuba ezi ntsuku zivela kweyiphi iRamadan?
qadaa.form.knowsYearSubtitle: Ndiyayazi ukuba ezi ntsuku zivela kweyiphi iRamadan.
qadaa.form.unknownYearSubtitle: Ezi ntsuku ziyinxalenye yebhalansi yam yangaphambili.
qadaa.form.yearRequiredError: Khetha unyaka weRamadan, okanye ukhethe "Hayi, andikhumbuli".
qadaa.deleteModal.title: Cima ezi ntsuku?
qadaa.deleteModal.body_one: Uza kucima {{quantityLabel}} elongezwe ngesandla. Esi senzo siza kuzisusa ezi ntsuku kwibhalansi yakho yeentsuku zokuzila ezifanele ziphindwe.
qadaa.deleteModal.body_other: Uza kucima {{quantityLabel}} elongezwe ngesandla. Esi senzo siza kuzisusa ezi ntsuku kwibhalansi yakho yeentsuku zokuzila ezifanele ziphindwe.
qadaa.deleteModal.reassurance: Esi senzo siza kucima kuphela olu ngeniso longezwe ngesandla. Iintsuku zakho ezifunyenwe ngokuzenzekelayo neziphindiweyo ngaphambili aziachaphazeleki.
qadaa.errors.quantityMin: Inani leentsuku kufuneka libe ngokuncinane li-1.
qadaa.errors.yearFormat: Faka unyaka onamanani amane (umz. 1445 okanye 2018), okanye ukhethe "Unyaka awaziwa".
qadaa.errors.yearInvalid: Olu nyaka aluboni lusebenza. Sebenzisa unyaka weHijri (umz. 1445) okanye unyaka weGregory (umz. 2018).

awaADeux.partnerSide.advice.generalSuppo: Hlala unengqalelo kwaye unikezele ngoncedo lwakho, ungafuni ukwazi iinkcukacha zomjikelo wakhe.

awaADeux.partnerSide.advice.phaseTipFoll: Ukwinqanaba lakhe le-follicular: eli lixesha apho amandla ahlala ebuya — ithuba elihle lokuphuma okanye lokwenza iprojekthi kunye.
awaADeux.partnerSide.advice.phaseTipFert: Ukwixesha lakhe lokukwazi ukukhulelwa: akukho nto ikhethekileyo ekufuneka uyenze, ngaphandle kokuba nizama ukukhulelwa kunye.
